description: This Java class CustomAuthenticationProvider extends Spring Security's DaoAuthenticationProvider to add custom account lock handling based on user lock status, integrating with UserService to determine lock status and whether the lock period has expired.

classes.name: CustomAuthenticationProvider
classes.description: A custom authentication provider that extends DaoAuthenticationProvider to add account lock status verification.

methods.name: CustomAuthenticationProvider
methods.description: Constructor that injects a UserService instance.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Overrides the default authenticate method to check if the user's account is locked and whether it should be unlocked, throwing a LockedException if the account is still locked.
